collection.description: A child refuses to hug a visiting relative despite the family's expectations.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) refuses to hug (relative), a visiting relative, despite the family's expectations.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (relative) accepts a cheerful hello without a hug.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) stays close to (adult), a trusted adult, until comfortable.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) happily waves from across the gathering.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) chooses not to greet anyone immediately.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (relative) feels disappointed but respects the boundary.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) learns several ways to greet guests.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) explains that affection should not be forced.
